content:
LAS VEGAS, Oct. 28, 2026 - Last Friday's release of the Pentagon's seventh batch of declassified Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena documents has drawn widespread attention for its account of a silent black triangular craft witnessed by three federal agents. But for those who read beyond the headlines, the Oct. 23 release contains something arguably more profound - a 60-page government contractor file documenting shape-shifting beings, dimensional anomalies, and an alleged interdimensional portal, alongside the on-the-record testimony of a shaman.

For Marysol Rezanov, founder of Tierra Del Sol in Las Vegas and a formally trained practitioner within the ancient Andean Q'ero Nation lineage, the release marks a watershed moment that most of the mainstream has overlooked entirely.

What the Release Actually Contains

The seventh PURSUE batch, published on WAR.GOV/UFO on October 23, 2026, includes 28 declassified files. One of them, titled Utah Ranch Investigation, is a 2010 report produced by Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS) - a Pentagon contractor hired to investigate the phenomena occurring at Utah's Skinwalker Ranch.

Among the file's documented findings:

• Interviews with more than 25 individuals, including a shaman who was formally consulted about the phenomena in the region
• A seven-foot bipedal creature witnessed striking a barbed-wire fence at extraordinary speed
• Multiple sightings of dog-like bipedal entities
• Reports of "little people" and pterodactyl-like aerial creatures
• Encounters with giant worm-like beings
• Fur samples submitted for DNA analysis
• Most notably, a witness account of what was believed to be a doorway to another world - a portal described as "rippling water"

The Pentagon's release also includes the famous Walter Haut Roswell affidavit, previously known only through published books, now officially entering federal archives.

Why This Release Matters More Than the Previous Six

Earlier PURSUE releases focused primarily on sensor data, pilot encounters, and historical UFO records - material that fit within a conventional aerospace framework. The seventh release crosses into territory that mainstream institutions have traditionally dismissed as paranormal - shape-shifters, dimensional phenomena, consciousness-based encounters, and the ancient spiritual knowledge systems that have long described all of it.

That the United States government has now entered this language into federal archives, through official documentation of a shaman's consultation and multiple witness accounts of interdimensional phenomena, is historically significant.

For Marysol, it is also personally significant. She has spent years publicly speaking to the reality of Interdimensional Beings, holding that position long before mainstream disclosure caught up. Last week's release gives her words a kind of institutional documentation they have not previously had.

What Shamanic Traditions Have Always Known

Shamans across indigenous traditions have described exactly what the Pentagon file now documents. Beings that move between dimensions. Thresholds in the natural world where the veil thins. Shape-shifting entities. Realities layered on top of ordinary reality. Portals that appear and disappear. These are not new concepts. They are among the oldest teachings in human history.

What is new is the recognition.

"Indigenous traditions have mapped this territory for thousands of years," Marysol said. "What the Pentagon just released is not a discovery. It is a catching-up. The old wisdom described all of it long before any contractor was ever hired to investigate."

Who Is Marysol Rezanov?

Marysol Rezanov is a Las Vegas-based shaman, lightworker, and spiritual guide, and the founder of Tierra Del Sol. Her shamanic experience is carried through biological lineage, reinforced by many years of formal training as a Pampamesayoq and Chakaruna within the ancient Andean Q'ero Nation tradition of Peru - a lineage widely regarded as the last direct inheritors of Incan spiritual wisdom. Her indigenous healing practice is further grounded in the wisdom traditions of Ancient Egypt. She identifies as an Indigo Lightworker.

She also brings nearly two decades of professional experience in the mental health field, having completed the Master of Social Work program at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas. Tierra Del Sol operates entirely separately from that work and is offered as an alternative spiritual path.

What This Means for Experiencers

Many of the clients who come to Tierra Del Sol have carried similar experiences in silence for years - contact with beings that defied classification, encounters that did not fit any available framework, moments where reality itself seemed to shift. For these individuals, the Pentagon's seventh release provides something that has long been missing - institutional acknowledgment that their experiences are not isolated, not fabricated, and not confined to the fringe.

Marysol continues to offer dedicated support for UAP and NHI experiencers, integrating authentic shamanic practice with trauma-informed care. Her work addresses intrusive memories, energetic imprints, recovery from implants and vibrational frequency disturbances, and the deeper spiritual integration required when one's understanding of reality shifts fundamentally.

A Convergence Long in the Making

The release also follows a January 2026 peer-reviewed scientific paper documenting unexplained electromagnetic and radiation anomalies at Skinwalker Ranch across three field seasons. Together, the governmental documentation, the academic physics research, and the ancient shamanic knowledge are now pointing at the same reality from three different directions.

For Marysol, this convergence has been inevitable. The frameworks are different. The truth they are describing is the same.

In Her Own Words

"When a federal contractor's report officially describes a portal to another world, interviews a shaman as part of the investigation, and documents beings that move between dimensions, we are living in a moment that would have been unthinkable just a few years ago. For every experiencer who was told they imagined it, for every indigenous tradition that was dismissed as superstition, this is vindication. The ancient wisdom was never wrong. The world is finally beginning to see it."

- Marysol Rezanov, Founder, Tierra Del Sol
